think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed values from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether it is a numeric parameter with a natural ordering. 3) If numeric, look for sentinel values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch behavior (disable/auto/special mode) rather than representing a magnitude. 4) Determine whether such sentinel values exist and are meaningfully different from normal operation. 5) Classify as special knob only if it is numeric and has such special sentinel values; otherwise classify as not special.
